question.text: In a class of 100 students there are 70 boys whose average marks in a subject are 75. If the average marks of the complete class is 72, then what is the average of the girls?

solution.text:
Total student $=100 ;$ for 70 stds $75 \times 70=5250 \Rightarrow 7200-5250=1950$
$$
\text { Average of girls }=\frac{1950}{30}=65
$$
